cooked: One useful control would be to compare reconstruction outcomes for the same block across nodes, split by high- versus low-bandwidth mode. That holds the block’s transaction set constant and helps separate mempool-policy effects from differences in announcement timing or peer selection. The mempoolfullrbf change is suggestive, but a before/after comparison alone can’t rule out changes in the transactions miners were including.
